_meta.rules: Усі числа — заявлені самою компанією на її власному сайті (sourceUrl). Цін і доступності немає навмисно. Профілі Trustpilot — лише URL, і лише якщо посилання стояло на сайті самої компанії; trustpilot.com не відкривався. Відсутній рядок сервісу = «не перевіряли», unavailable = компанія прямо пише, що не дає. Тексти intro/whatToKnow — мовою en.

providers.name: McRent
providers.intro: Rental brand of Rental Alliance GmbH (Erwin Hymer Group, Isny im Allgäu); started in 2004 with 8 stations in Germany. The “2025” slide on the About page: “16 countries across Europe and in New Zealand, with more than 100 stations and 3,000 vehicles worldwide” — stations “more than 100”, the figures are worldwide (including New Zealand).
providers.whatToKnow: From 16.11.2026 the rent easy brand is merging into McRent (“over 130 locations” at https://www.mcrent.eu/mcrent-and-rent-easy/). The site renders with JS: the figures are visible only with the X-Locale header or in a browser. Other stated station counts: REST /appl/rest/stations = 96, rental-alliance.com (2022) = 106. The holding company at erwinhymergroup.com writes “mehr als 2.500 Fahrzeugen”. The contract counterparty is the local station (a Rental Alliance licensee).

providers.name: roadsurfer
providers.intro: Munich-based campervan and motorhome rental with its own fleet (roadsurfer GmbH, founded 2016), also a campervan subscription, sales, and the roadsurfer spots platform of parking spots. The figures are WORLDWIDE (16 countries, including the USA and Canada): the About page — “100 locations worldwide” and “10,000 vehicles”; the 2026 press kit — “nearly 100” and “around 10,000”.
providers.whatToKnow: Press release of 11.02.2026 (roadsurfer.com/wp-content/uploads/260211_PM-Neue-Stationen-DACH_final.pdf): “mehr als 10.000 Fahrzeugen an rund 100 Standorten in 16 Ländern”, 37 stations in Germany. There is no phone number on the contact pages or in the imprint — the mobility number is issued in the account chat.

providers.name: Indie Campers
providers.intro: Lisbon-based road-trip platform (founded 2013) that has operated in Europe in a hybrid model since 2020: its own fleet plus a p2p marketplace of vehicles from private owners (Europe only); it also sells used campervans and owns the Bunk Campers / Just Go brands in the United Kingdom and Ireland. The figures are WORLDWIDE (Europe, USA/Canada, Australia/NZ) and “more than” figures: fact sheet — “over 100 physical locations” and “global fleet exceeds 10,000 owned vehicles”.
providers.whatToKnow: The legal name is taken from the company's own PDF (https://indiecampers.com/pdf/FichaProjeto_IC.pdf); there is no registration number on the site or in the Terms. Rental Agreement for Europe: the lessor — “company belonging to the Indie Campers group registered in the Country where the selected vehicle is”. The phone number in the site footer is a US number; the email is taken from the Rental Agreement (help.indiecampers.com, article 48843149456785). Model lengths are given as a range — the lower bound is used.

providers.name: rent easy

In the imprint the number is written as “HB 621035” (on mcrent.eu the same number is written as HRB 621035). 250 km/day included, all km — only from day 15.

providers.name: Blacksheep Van
providers.intro: French franchise network renting equipped campervan trucks (the first agency opened in 2011 near Lyon). The agencies page lists 30: 24 in France (including Réunion), 2 in Ireland, 1 in Greece (EU-27), plus 2 in Switzerland and 1 in Canada. The “Qui sommes-nous” page says “plus de 50 agences” and “plus de 500 vans” — the fleet field takes 500 (“more than”), the depot field takes the lower of the two numbers.
providers.whatToKnow: The link to the Trustpilot profile is in the footer of the company's own site (https://www.blacksheep-van.com/en/ and the model pages) — the URL was taken from there. Discrepancies within the sources themselves: the countries on the “about us” page (FR, BE, CH, IT, IE, PT) do not match the agency list (FR, CH, CA, IE, GR); in the mentions légales the email is written “contact@blackheep-van.com” (without the s), the mailto in the rental terms is “contact@blacksheep-van.com”; CGL §14.07 mentions a fixed mileage in the base rate, whereas the FAQ and the model pages say “unlimited”. The phone number on the site is in the national format 09 51 38 88 15.

providers.name: DRM
providers.intro: German campervan rental headquartered in Markt Schwaben (Bavaria), founded 1994, part of Trigano Group; stations in Germany only; all km included in the price, dogs free of charge, vehicles less than three years old (Eura Mobil, Karmann Mobil, Forster, Volkswagen). The company page: “600+ vehicles, 14+ locations” — both figures are “more than”.
providers.whatToKnow: 15 stations are listed at https://www.drm.de/en/locations — the field takes the lower stated number (14). One-way and airport transfer are not mentioned on the 25 pages reviewed — there are no rows for them.

providers.name: CROSSRENT
providers.intro: The third rental brand of Rental Alliance GmbH (Erwin Hymer Group) alongside McRent and rent easy; founded 12/2020, rentals since 06/2021; franchise “Bases” rent out compact campervans, semi-integrated motorhomes and a pickup with a rooftop tent, partly 4x4; 300 km per rental night included, all km — from day 15. The company's own site lists 14 stations: 12 in Germany and 1 in Sweden (EU-27) plus 1 in the United Kingdom.
providers.whatToKnow: The holding company's page https://www.rental-alliance.com/unsere-marken/crossrent.html says “Insgesamt 23 Stationen (22x DE, 1x CH)” as of 10/2022 — the field takes the lower, current number 14 (station page data: REST https://www.cross-rent.de/appl/rest/stations with the X-Locale header). The founding year is from the holding company's timeline (“12/2020 Gründung”). The brand's fleet size is not named anywhere (erwinhymergroup.com gives only the figure for all of Rental Alliance). The contract counterparty is the local Base (a Rental Alliance licensee). One-way: AGB clause 3.7 “nur bei gesonderter Vereinbarung” — no row added.

providers.name: Touring Cars
providers.intro: Finnish franchise network of motorhome rental (platform TC Vehicle Oy, Vantaa; franchising since 2013), founded 1982; “10 local stations” in “8 countries”. Stations in the EU-27: Helsinki-Vantaa, Rovaniemi (FI), Stockholm (SE), Amsterdam (NL), Madrid (ES), Tallinn (EE); outside the EU: Oslo, Tromsø (NO), Keflavik (IS), Chester (GB). The site does not name the fleet size.
providers.whatToKnow: The rental contract is concluded with the local Rental Company, TC Vehicle Oy is an intermediary (https://www.touringcars.com/en/general-rental-terms/). The category pages give only “Number of people 1–2 / 1–4 / 1–5” and the length as a range (SMALL/MEDIUM/LUXURY “5.9–7.6 m”, FAMILY “6.3–7.6 m”) — so beltedSeats and lengthCm are empty. The minimum age depends on the station (FI/SE 19, EE/GB 21, NL/IS 23, NO 25).

providers.name: Yescapa
providers.intro: P2P marketplace (an intermediary, not a fleet owner): it describes itself as “RV rental platform between private individuals”, headquartered in Bordeaux, operating “across the UK and Europe”; the home page also lists Canada, USA and Australia as destinations. Vehicles — “Over 24,000 vehicles” on the home page (“more than”); meanwhile the <title> of the category pages says “12500 Vehicles Available”.
providers.whatToKnow: There are no depots under this model. The about/press/legal-notice pages on the site return 404, /contact-us/ redirects to the login — so email, phone and founding year are empty (the only address on the site is dpo@yescapa.com, this is the DPO, not a contact). The merger with Goboony is not mentioned in the site's prose text (only in JS). Services marked “at the owner's decision” are listing options set by the vehicle owner. The category characteristics depend on the specific vehicle — empty.

providers.name: PaulCamper
providers.intro: P2P platform (an intermediary, not a fleet owner): it describes itself as “Deutschlands größte Peer-to-Peer-Plattform für Camper, Wohnmobile und Wohnwagen”, Berlin; “in sechs Ländern zuhause” — own sites paulcamper.de/.at/.nl, the rest through camplify.*. The home page has two figures: “12.000+ Fahrzeugen” and “Knapp 24.000 Fahrzeuge” — the field takes the lower (“more than 12 000”).
providers.whatToKnow: There are no depots under this model. Founding year: “seit 2013” at https://www.paulcamper.de/ueber-uns, “seit 2014” on the home page — 2013 is used. Belonging to Camplify is not stated in prose on the site (only links to camplify.*). The imprint gives impressum@paulcamper.de (“nicht für Buchung und Beratung”); the field takes info@paulcamper.de and the phone number from the contact page of the help centre (https://help.paulcamper.com/pc-helpcenter/kontaktaufnahme-mit-paulcamper). Services “at the owner's decision” are determined by the vehicle owner. The category characteristics depend on the specific vehicle — empty.
